facts: Use the default ignore factory to create an ignore manager.
The package exposes an isPathValid helper.
Call add() before filter().
The canonical filter example keeps .abc/d/e.js after a negative pattern.
ignores(pathname) returns a boolean for one pathname.
createFilter() returns a predicate usable with Array.prototype.filter.
Read the ignore file contents and pass the string to add().
Pathnames should be relative by default.
Absolute Windows paths are invalid by default.
allowRelativePaths relaxes validation.
The docs warn that ./foo or ../foo can lead to unexpected behavior.
test(pathname) returns ignored and unignored booleans.
Import v4 as uuidv4 from uuid.
v4 creates a random UUID.
Import v7 as uuidv7 from uuid.
v7 creates a Unix epoch time-based UUID.
validate(str) returns true for valid UUIDs and false otherwise.
Combine validate(uuid) with version(uuid) === 4 for v4-only validation.
version() returns 0 for NIL and 15 for MAX.
parse converts a UUID string to bytes.
stringify converts bytes to a UUID string.
Starting with uuid@12, CommonJS is no longer supported.
uuid@14 is an ES module package.
The CLI defaults to v4 UUIDs.
The documented CLI supports v1, v3, v4, v5, and v7.
v4 uses crypto.randomUUID() when no buffer, no options, and crypto.randomUUID is available.
Starting in uuid@11, the presence of options selects separate behavior for timestamp UUIDs.
Construct Fuse with a list and options, then call search(pattern).
includeScore includes result scores.
threshold controls when the match algorithm gives up.
Fuse.createIndex creates an index.
Fuse.parseIndex parses a serialized index.
setCollection replaces docs.
add adds a document.
remove and removeAt remove documents.
Package exports include root, min, basic, and min-basic entry points.
